# GL.iNet Provider

Manage network interfaces, Wi-Fi, DHCP, DNS, and firewall settings on GL.iNet Flint 2 (GL-MT6000) running stock firmware 4.11.0 in router mode. The provider connects over verified SSH.

## Check the router

Set these environment variables before you run Terraform.

| Variable | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `GLINET_HOST` | The router's hostname or private LAN IP address. |
| `GLINET_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE` | The path to an unencrypted OpenSSH Ed25519 or RSA key authorized for `root` on the router. |
| `GLINET_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE` | The path to a known-hosts file with the router's host key. Verify the key through a trusted channel before adding it. |

Save this example as `main.tf` in an empty directory.

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    glinet = {
      source  = "elephant-evergreen/glinet"
      version = "~> 0.1.2"
    }
  }
}

provider "glinet" {}

data "glinet_system" "router" {}

output "router" {
  value = {
    model    = data.glinet_system.router.model
    firmware = data.glinet_system.router.firmware
    mode     = data.glinet_system.router.mode
  }
}
```

1. Run `terraform init`.
2. Run `terraform plan`. In the planned `router` output, look for model `GL.iNet GL-MT6000`, firmware `4.11.0`, and mode `router`. This check reads the router over SSH without an apply.

If the plan cannot connect, confirm SSH is enabled and check the host, root key and verified host-key entry.

## Adopt existing settings

In the **Resources** sidebar, choose the setting you want to manage and follow **Import existing configuration**. See the [hardware testing scope](https://github.com/elephant-evergreen/terraform-provider-glinet/blob/main/docs/testing.md) before making a change.

Keep `.terraform.lock.hcl` in version control. Before upgrading, read the [release notes for your target version](https://github.com/elephant-evergreen/terraform-provider-glinet/releases), then run `terraform init -upgrade` and review the lock file and plan.

## Schema

### Optional

- `backup_directory` (String) Directory for verified age-encrypted full router configuration backups. Falls back to `GLINET_BACKUP_DIRECTORY`, then the operating system user configuration directory under `glinet/backups`. The SSH private key decrypts these backups. A backup is required before the first mutation of each apply; backup failure prevents all changes.
- `host` (String) Router hostname or IP address. Falls back to `GLINET_HOST`.
- `known_hosts_file` (String) Path to a known_hosts file containing the verified router host key. Falls back to `GLINET_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE`. Host-key verification is always required.
- `port` (Number) SSH port. Falls back to `GLINET_PORT`, then `22`.
- `private_key_file` (String) Path to an unencrypted OpenSSH private key for root. Falls back to `GLINET_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE`. Key contents are not part of the provider schema.
